desc: Ideation: select 3D monotone spanning-tree max-heap enumeration with truncation to min(N,K).
Implement the complete Python solution with bit-packed 3D heap keys, canonical-child insertion, and K-pop output.
Verify samples and edge cases; sample tests passed and the algorithm handles N=1, K=1, K=N^3, duplicates, and large values.
Finalize; complexity is O(N log N + K log K), within the constraints for K <= 5e5.
